nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Soil health management|Soil carbon sequestration_qna_000
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How can biochar application impact carbon sequestration and climate change?
nodes.answer: Biochar application to soil can provide long-term carbon sequestration, reduce yearly greenhouse emissions, and ultimately mitigate climate change.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Soil health management|Soil carbon sequestration_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How does soil carbon sequestration in agroforestry systems contribute to climate change mitigation?
nodes.answer: Soil carbon sequestration in agroforestry systems helps in reducing the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, thus mitigating climate change.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Soil health management|Soil carbon sequestration_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How much carbon did the P. nigra SOGF store in standing volume?
nodes.answer: The P. nigra SOGF stored 69.9 tons of carbon per hectare in standing volume.
